Remediation is per POLICY, not per initiative

week-13 — assigning the initiative changed nothing for resources that already existed
# The initiative holds 69 policies. Evaluation found three with a
# matching resource in this subscription:

    keyvault-vaults                    Compliant
    network-publicipaddresses          Compliant
    operationalinsights-workspaces     Compliant

# A remediation task is required for EACH, named by its
# policyDefinitionReferenceId. One initiative, three tasks:

$ az policy remediation create --definition-reference-id <ref> ...

    rem-keyvault-vaults                  Succeeded   1 deployment
    rem-network-publicipaddresses        Succeeded   1 deployment
    rem-operationalinsights-workspaces   Succeeded   1 deployment

# Without these the assignment only affects resources created AFTER it.
#
# Compliance lags reality: the public IP read NonCompliant for minutes
# after its setting existed. The settings themselves were checked
# per-resource rather than read off the dashboard.
